description: Metadata-only record of live source integration attempts and remaining technical blockers. No source geometries or personal fields are stored.

attempts.operation: 3x3 viewport plus 0.004-degree pan; exact NIB round trips

failureClasses: short NIB values are reused across administrative areas and exact NIB retrieval returns conflicting polygons
blank or whitespace NIB values map to multiple polygons in two pan cells

technicalBlockers: No durable native parcel key is established: NIB exact lookups are non-unique across the layer.
Whitespace NIB values cause conflicting-geometry failures in bounded cells.

result.note: All tested city-center cells returned zero features; no exact-ID test was possible. The previous nonempty sample is outside Semarang city.

technicalBlockers: No parcel coverage was returned in the tested Semarang city-center viewport; current evidence does not establish usable city coverage.

attempts.operation: 3x3 viewport plus 0.004-degree pan; exact NIB round trips

failureClasses: short NIB values are reused across administrative areas and exact NIB retrieval returns conflicting polygons
blank NIB query expanded to 776 layer features

technicalBlockers: No durable native parcel key is established: NIB exact lookups are non-unique across administrative areas.
Blank NIB exact lookup is non-selective and returns hundreds of unrelated layer features.

attempts.operation: Native-key uniqueness preflight and bounded first-page requests
technicalBlockers: CityCode plus BoundaryId returns multiple distinct polygons in both Tokyo and Nagoya; no permanent native key is exposed by this layer.
Complete paging and all-key exact retrieval were not run after the key prerequisite failed.

attempts.operation: Static object availability and candidate-key cardinality assessment
technicalBlockers: Static bulk GeoJSON has no bbox-query contract; live integration requires a snapshot reader and spatial index.
The single ID field is not unique; candidate composites require implementation and exact-read validation.
Evidence covers only the Chuo ward public-coordinate package, not all Osaka.

subsequentResolution.detail: The failed attempt is retained as history; a verified scoped adapter now serves this source.

attempts.operation: Complete bounded viewport, pagination, native GLOBALID exact round trips
technicalBlockers: Most tested nonempty cells are rejected for invalid polygon geometry.
Several cells fail closed because pagination repeats or omits object IDs.

attempts.operation: 3x3 viewport plus 0.004-degree pan; native INSPIREID validation
technicalBlockers: INSPIREID contains the non-title placeholder “No LR Title Detected” in six audited rows; these values fail the numeric native-ID contract in ten bounded cells.
No successful feature set remained for exact-ID round-trip testing.

subsequentResolution.detail: The failed attempt is retained as history; a verified scoped adapter now serves this source.

attempts.operation: 3x3 viewport plus 0.004-degree pan; exact DSQFL round trips on retained IDs
technicalBlockers: DSQFL yields conflicting polygon geometries within three bounded spatial cells; the full spatial read cannot be accepted until these same-key geometry conflicts are resolved or represented safely.

adapterClarifications.finding: ArcGIS zero-result object-ID manifest probes returned null/omitted objectIds and the earlier adapter rejected them. The root implementation now handles count=0; this is an adapter contract edge, not provider unavailability.
